entities.name: Estel
entities.description: A young blond human boy of Tidehollow on Esper whom Tezzeret sends on a mission to Bant.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who gave Estel an etherium box, a weapon and a mission.

entities.name: Tidehollow
entities.description: Forsaken, filthy underground place on Esper where Estel lives.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: Knight-General on Bant to whom Estel is sent for help.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Knight-General Rafiq is.

events.summary: Estel is pushed into the gutter by his peers and left behind.
events.quote: was pushed into the gutter by his peers and left behind

events.summary: Tezzeret meets Estel and gives him an etherium box, a weapon, and a mission to seek help from Rafiq in Bant.
events.quote: offered him a rare opportunity for escape by giving him an etherium box, a weapon, and a mission to seek help from Knight-General Rafiq in Bant
